why_there_is_no_shield_id: This file used to carry SHIELD-2026-0000. That identifier resolved to nothing: our own registry returned not_registered for it and for this domain. Our badge page tells applicants that an identifier that was never issued displays as unrecognised, and an agent following our own published protocol — read the file, check it against the registry — got a contradiction on our own domain. The identifier has been withdrawn rather than fabricated into existence.
why_we_do_not_certify_ourselves: Shield Certification is a human review in which a named reviewer signs a decision about a third party. An issuer that grants itself the credential it sells has certified nothing, and the registry would be recording an assertion rather than a review. The registry contains certified third parties only. If this institution is ever to hold a verified identity credential, it will have to come from someone who is not us.
reference_example: https://lunarasociety.com/badge.html — the template a certified institution publishes, which does carry a shield_id, because theirs was issued.
